description: Use this to read the messages between the user and one other TraydStar member, oldest first. Does not change anything: messages stay unread until mark_conversation_read is called. Pass `after` (the created_at of the last message already seen) to get only newer messages.

after.description: Only return messages after this time (ISO 8601)

limit.description: How many messages to return (default 100, newest)

user_id.description: The other member in the conversation

name: read_conversation
title: Read a conversation
